name: A Favor for Evershine
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz needs Evershine for his siege engine, Jetsteam. Rejold Barleybrew will give up a cask only after you drive the predators away from Brewnall Village.

sections.title: A Brewer's Bargain
sections.body: Rejold offers his brew if you thin the wild beasts of western Dun Morogh. Ice Claw Bears, Elder Crag Boars, and Snow Leopards roam near Brewnall Village. Their presence endangers the locals and keeps Rejold from freely giving up the cask.

sections.title: Peace for the Craftsmen
sections.body: Rejold says no self-respecting dwarf cowers before wild animals. Yet watching for predators around the village takes the craftsmen valuable hours. Once the beasts are driven off, villagers can focus on distilling and smithing without keeping watch on the tree line.

faq.q: Why does Rejold want these animals killed?
faq.answer: Ice Claw Bears, Elder Crag Boars, and Snow Leopards prowl near Brewnall Village. The dwarves do not fear them, but driving the beasts off takes hours from brewing and crafting.
Evershine is a potent, celebrated liquor brewed only in Brewnall Village by Rejold Barleybrew. Siege engine pilots like Pilot Bellowfiz prize it as a drink and a volatile fuel additive.

faq.q: Who originally asked for the Evershine?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot sent you for Evershine to keep him warm on the road and feed into the furnace of his siege engine, Jetsteam, for a burst of power.

faq.q: Where can the animals be found?
faq.answer: The animals roam the frozen fields and crags around Brewnall Village and Iceflow Lake in western Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What happens after completing the favor?
faq.answer: Once the beasts are thinned, Rejold gives you a cask of Evershine to take back to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.

faq.q: Are the villagers in actual danger from the predators?
faq.answer: Rejold says no self-respecting dwarf fears a beast in the snow. Yet predators near the doorstep disrupt daily work and pose a danger.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know wild predators must be kept from an honest still.
As a gnome, you know the siege pilots and tinkerers at Steelgrill's Depot await the cask. They rely on adventurers to appease the stubborn brewer so Jetsteam's preparations can continue.
As a hunter, you test your marksmanship against the hardiest winter beasts in the crags of western Dun Morogh.
